  • Rober, M. “Mark Rober.” (YouTube channel.)
  • Solomon, F., D. Champion, et al. âEmbodied Physics: Utilizing Dance Resources for Learning and Engagement in STEM.â Journal of the Learning Sciences 31, no. 1 (2022): 73â106.

  • Senge, P., M. Boell, et al. “Introduction to Compassionate Systems Framework in Schools.” The Center for Systems Awareness, Abdul Latif Jameel World Education Lab (J-WEL), Massachusetts Institute of Technology. March 2019.

  • Keane, L., and M. Keane. “STEAM by Design.” Design and Technology Education 21, no. 1 (2016): 61â82.
  • Mansilla, V.B., and A. Schleicher. “Big Picture Thinking.” How to Educate the Whole Person for an Interconnected World: Principles and Practice. Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (2022).

  • Mann, A., V. Denis, et al. “Dream Jobs? Teenagers’ Career Aspirations and the Future of Work.” OECD, 2020.
  • Future Skills Map, 2021. Institute for the Future (IFTF) for the University of Phoenix Research Institute.

  • Arnold, K.D., E. Brown Soto, et al. “Post-Secondary Outcomes of Innovative High Schools: The Big Picture Longitudinal Study.” (2015).

  • Metarubric, MIT Playful Journey Lab (link no longer exists)

Session 15: Innovative Models, Part 2

  • Powderhouse Organization.
Additional Readings

  • Paniagua,Â A., and D.Â Istance. Teachers as Designers of Learning Environments: The Importance of Innovative Pedagogies, Educational Research and Innovation, OECD Publishing, Paris (2018).

  • Burdick, A. “Design Without Designers.” Paper based on presentation at the School of Design Strategies at Parsons The New School for Design, New York. April 29, 2009. License CC BY-NC.Â

Session 19: Concept Development

  • Thomas, C.J. “Building a Better World Through Education: 6 Big Ideas.” The Brookings Institution, July 16, 2020.

Session 20: Project Work / Introduction to Project-Based Learning

  • Capraro, R.M., and S.W. Slough. “Why PBL? Why STEM? Why Now? An Introduction to STEM Project-Based Learning.” In R.M. Capraro, M.M. Capraro, and J.R. Morgan (eds), STEM Project-Based Learning. SensePublishers, 2013.
  • “Day in the Life” (PDF). In Conceptual Design for a STEAM Lab School in Belize. Massachusetts Institute of Technology, 2020.

Session 21: Introduction to Playtesting

  • McDonald, J., and D. Allen. “Tuning Protocol: Examining Adult Work.” Center for Leadership and Educational Equity (CLEE). Â
